svg.title: One duplicated key and the total is wrong
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “One duplicated key and the total is wrong” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A whiteboard sketch showing a left table of three orders joined to a right table whose key A appears twice, ringed in red, so the result has four rows and the amount for A is counted twice, making a sum of 700 instead of 600 with no error; the fix of passing validate equals m colon 1 raising a MergeError instead; a bar chart of where a five-million-row DataFrame's 404.4 megabytes go, dominated by a 279.4 megabyte object column that becomes 5.0 megabytes as a category; and per-row costs of 112 nanoseconds for Series.apply against 0.4 nanoseconds vectorized, with iterrows at 9.33 microseconds per row struck through.
svg.text: One duplicated key and the total is wrong
draw it from memory, then compare
